verbatim_text:
[INTRO — Quiet, atmospheric, distant ocean]
One little island... One little boy... One big ocean... A world of possibilities.
Wake up... Wake up... The morning is calling.

[VERSE 1 — Gentle, curious male child vocal]
Sunlight dancing on my wall, Little shadows, big and tall. Hear the birds above the trees, Feel the morning ocean breeze.
Barefoot running through the sand, Little fishing rod in my hand. I don't know what's far away, But I have questions for today.

[PRE-CHORUS — Rhythm gradually builds]
What is waiting past the shore? What is there I haven't seen before?
Every wave can tell a story, Every day begins with possibility.

[CHORUS — Deep collective stadium chant, simple and memorable]
Zero, zero — here we go! One small step, a world to know! Round and round, the oceans flow, How far can a little dream go?
Hey! Hey! The world is wide! Hey! Hey! Come take the ride! From the shore to the great unknown, A little seed can become a world!

[VERSE 2 — More rhythmic, playful delivery]
Big boats waiting by the bay, Little fish that slip away. How do they know where fish will be? What lives beneath the deep blue sea?
I see the clouds, I see the sky, I see the birds that learn to fly. I may be small, but I can see, A thousand things that wait for me.

[PRE-CHORUS — Stronger percussion]
What is waiting past the shore? What is there I haven't seen before?
Every wave can tell a story, Every day begins with possibility.

[CHORUS — Full collective voices]
Zero, zero — here we go! One small step, a world to know! Round and round, the oceans flow, How far can a little dream go?
Hey! Hey! The world is wide! Hey! Hey! Come take the ride! From the shore to the great unknown, A little seed can become a world!

[BRIDGE — Music drops, intimate vocal]
I don't need to know it all, I don't need to stand up tall. I can ask and I can try, With open hands and curious eyes.
The sea is bigger than I know, But every journey starts below The morning sun, the sand, the sea... And one small question inside me.

[FINAL CHORUS — Deep group chant, biggest arrangement]
Zero, zero — here we go! One small step, a world to know! Round and round, the oceans flow, How far can a little dream go?
Hey! Hey! The world is wide! Hey! Hey! Come take the ride! From the shore to the great unknown, A little seed can become a world!

[OUTRO — Instruments fade into waves]
One little island... One little boy... One big ocean...
And tomorrow...
A thousand more questions.

version_label: Tide Pool & Sand — English Original — Draft 1
verbatim_text:
[INTRO — Gentle ocean waves, soft plucks, light log-drum pulse]
Splash, splash, little feet... Sand is warm beneath the heat. Drop a line, watch it sway... What will happen next today?

[VERSE 1 — Playful, curious young male lead]
Little crab walks sideways fast, Bubbles popping, gone so fast! Shiny shells in shades of white, Catching all the morning light.
Poke a stick and tap a stone, I am out here on my own. Nobody to rush me through, Every rock is something new.

[PRE-CHORUS — Hand drums and 808 groove lock in]
Click-clack, tap-tap, hear the beat, Ocean rhythm at my feet. Tiny ripples, big blue space, Smiling in this sunny place.

[CHORUS — Catchy hook + punchy low-to-mid group chant]
Step by step, watch me go! High tide rising, then it's low! Clap your hands and bounce along, Little island, big, big song!
Hey! Hey! Look and see! Hey! Hey! Wild and free! From the tide pool to the bay, Every moment leads the way!

[VERSE 2 — Rhythmic, bouncy delivery]
Little minnow, silver flash, Makes a tiny, quiet splash. Wiggle left and wiggle right, Hiding from the noon-day bright.
Can I catch a giant whale? Or a fish with rainbow tail? Maybe just a tiny breeze, Rustling through the coconut trees!

[PRE-CHORUS — Bright plucks and percussion build]
Click-clack, tap-tap, hear the beat, Ocean rhythm at my feet. Tiny ripples, big blue space, Smiling in this sunny place.

[CHORUS — Full collective voices and deep 808 groove]
Step by step, watch me go! High tide rising, then it's low! Clap your hands and bounce along, Little island, big, big song!
Hey! Hey! Look and see! Hey! Hey! Wild and free! From the tide pool to the bay, Every moment leads the way!

[BRIDGE — Drums strip back to ocean ambience, plucks, and warm vocal]
I don't catch a thing today... Still the best part of the day. Looking closer, learning slow, Finding things I didn't know.

[FINAL CHORUS — Full energy, group chant, and island percussion]
Step by step, watch me go! High tide rising, then it's low! Clap your hands and bounce along, Little island, big, big song!
Hey! Hey! Look and see! Hey! Hey! Wild and free! From the tide pool to the bay, Every moment leads the way!

[OUTRO — Groove winds down into waves and a final playful pluck]
Little crab... Little wave... One big day... Here I stay.
